Embrace the abyss with this Behemoth-inspired blackened death metal hoodie. Drawing from the occult grandeur and relentless intensity of Poland's most iconic extreme metal act, this gothic pullover features dark artwork that captures the blasphemous beauty of albums like 'The Satanist.'

This is not casual wear — it is a declaration. The bold graphic design channels the theatrical darkness and philosophical depth that Nergal has brought to extreme metal for decades. Heavyweight premium fleece ensures you stay warm whether you are at an outdoor festival or prowling city streets after midnight.

An essential heavy metal gift for fans of blackened death metal, occult aesthetics, and uncompromising alternative fashion. This hoodie speaks the language of those who find beauty in the extreme and meaning in the dark.

Features include a spacious kangaroo pocket, reinforced ribbed cuffs and hem, soft brushed interior, and an adjustable drawstring hood. Underground exclusive — for the select few who walk the left-hand path.
